title: Marvelous Designer SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 Hong Kong Exhibition Review
description:
SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 in Hong Kong has successfully concluded! From the hardcore live demonstrations of version 2025.2 to the extremely popular Magic Elephant lottery, here’s a 3-minute recap of every high-energy moment of Marvelous Designer in Hong Kong.

See you next time!

summary: # Marvelous Designer SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 Hong Kong Exhibition Review ## Introduction to Marvelous Designer Marvelous Designer is a 3D cloth simulation software that enables users to create digital clothing that mimics real-life garments. Instead of sculpting from solid objects, users can easily create patterns, cut them, and sew them together. This allows for a realistic movement simulation of the garments in a virtual environment. ## Experience at SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 The Seagroup Asia experience has been truly fascinating. During the event, we had the opportunity to meet a variety of users, including personal users, student users, and enterprise-level users. It was enlightening to see how these different demographics engage with the software. ## User Applications Users are not only focused on clothing creation but are also working on a wide range of environmental assets. This broadens the scope of Marvelous Designer's application and motivates us to expand further into different industries. ## Time-Efficiency and Future Expectations The software, referred to as MD, has significantly saved me time. I have been able to create realistic clothing quickly and efficiently. Looking ahead, I hope that MD will continue to evolve and introduce more features that enhance user experience and capabilities.
